page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the ecs.r7 family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance features 128 vCPUs and 1024.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:8 vCPU-to-memory ratio. This hardware configuration runs on the KVM hypervisor.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. However, it does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage volumes. Additionally, the server does not feature any dedicated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density per vCPU makes this instance suitable for workloads requiring large in-memory datasets without the overhead of paying for unnecessary compute resources. Tradeoffs include the lack of local NVMe storage and hardware acceleration. It is designed for memory-intensive workloads such as large-scale databases, in-memory caching, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy data processing pipelines.
